title: Solar rechargeable battery using the lithium-ion storage mechanism in high capacity MoO3 films
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,617-626
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01177E, Paper
Min Sun, Zhijun Liang, Kai Zhang, Yanhong Lin, Dejun Wang, Tengfeng Xie, Yu Zhang
A TiO2/MoO3/N3//I−/I3−/Pt solar rechargeable device is designed and attains a discharge capacity of 0.0103 mA h cm−2 in 5 min and a conversion efficiency of 1.80% under 1 sun illumination.
